fields.description: STALE: ctxgraph-cli/Cargo.toml already uses rustls-tls (reqwest = { features = ["blocking", "json", "rustls-tls"] }). Build works without OpenSSL dev headers. No fix needed.
STALE: Parent B1 resolved — reqwest already uses rustls-tls in ctxgraph-cli/Cargo.toml.
STALE: Parent B1 resolved — cargo build --release succeeds without OpenSSL.

DEFRERED: Contradictions are not persisted to a table — they are computed on-the-fly by check_contradictions(). Adding a count would require either persisting contradictions or scanning all edges at stats time, both over-engineering for current needs. Revisit if contradiction tracking is needed for re-verify workflow (B1).
